pages.title: Up & Down Quarks
pages.text: The two lightest quark flavours, carrying charges of plus two-thirds and minus one-third. Two ups and a down make a proton; two downs and an up make a neutron; so nearly every atom ever touched is built from these. Confinement means they never appear alone, and the pair sits in the palm with a stubborn, sticky pull.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Virtual quarks from the Quantum Foam vanish almost as soon as they appear. Running them through the Particle Spectrometer under superfluid helium, I could sort them by mass, and the two lightest flavours came out first and most often.
